Definition: to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken
BiblicalUsage: Chashak is being dark, darkening, and it is the plague and the prophecy alike. The locusts covered the face of the whole earth so that the land was darkened, God makes the day dark with night and turns the shadow of death into morning, He will cause the sun to go down at noon and darken the earth in the clear day, and the Preacher says the sun and the light shall be darkened before the evil days come.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe darkness in these verses is always God's doing, whether plague or prophecy: He darkens the land of Egypt and He darkens the noon of Israel's judgment. I hold that the God who makes the day dark is the same God who turns the shadow of death into morning, and the Preacher's warning is to remember Him before the light fails.
